Tabler Icons 3.50.0 — generic module pictograms

Pinned source commit: 6904efd245391ad396df17654738f52f6da8c40e
Source repository: https://github.com/tabler/tabler-icons

The application uses generic pictograms, not Tabler brand icons. All 19 former product marks have been replaced. PNGs use a 160x160 white canvas, a centered 112x112 outline glyph and neutral slate stroke.

Module file -> Tabler outline glyph -> pinned SVG source
